title: Jacob Salmon comes together with Justis Chanell to release a must-hear sound titled “Fight Another Day”
htmlContent:
Fast-rising music artist Jacob Salmon is a multi-talented singer and songwriter from Denmark. Despite not coming from a music background, Jacob Salmon has always had a particular spot for music in his heart. Today, Jacob Salmon came together with Justis Chanell to create a must-hear sound titled "Fight Another Day."

Jacob Salmon and Justis Chanell's recent song "Fight Another Day" is a soulful R&B track that talks about keeping your dreams alive and the willingness to keep going day after day despite the obstacles that may come your way. The rhymes are delivered perfectly to make it all confirmed for the listener on this enjoyable track with great appeal to go far.
